propositions: GitHub re-evaluates job-level if conditions during workflow cancellation; jobs with always() predicates remain true and are not canceled even when a run is superseded.

Seven full-route jobs in commit 6f4123678c have leading always() predicates that prevent prompt cancellation, causing 1785 runner-seconds of wasted work and 1510 seconds of successor admission delay in run pair 31834162663 → 31834896849.

Replacing the cancellation status portion of the seven full-route predicates with !cancelled() checks preserves docs-only classification and classifier-failure fallback behavior while enabling prompt cancellation of superseded runs.
Live organic patchset replacements (PS3→PS4→PS5 on change 1790) confirm stale jobs now cancel within 61-110 seconds of successor creation instead of running to natural completion.
